chunks: Yūnus narrated from Abī al-Ḥasan al-Māḍī عليه السلام, who said:
"The people guilty of all major sins, when the hadd is carried out upon them twice, they are killed on the third time."

key_terms.أَصْحَابُ: those characterized by or involved in

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for someone who repeatedly commits a major sin after the hadd has been carried out twice?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning those who repeatedly commit major sins for which a hadd punishment is applied. It indicates that after the hadd has been enforced twice, the punishment on the third occurrence is execution.
